build_verification: Xcode DeviceInteractionInstallAndRun initiated a successful build of the current checkout on 2026-11-06, confirmed by GetBuildLog. The workspace launch session failed to connect; the resulting Debug-iphonesimulator/SimpleScripture.app was then installed and launched successfully using simctl.
capture_method: xcrun simctl io <device> screenshot; native 2064 × 2752 pixel PNGs; no image scaling or modifications. Xcode DeviceInteractionSynthesize was used to inspect accessibility hierarchy and navigate, but its reduced-resolution screenshots are not the final sources.
appearance: Light; status bar overridden to 09:41, full Wi-Fi and 100% charged battery. Overrides cleared and this simulator shut down after capture.
font: Temporary per-launch fontNamePreference=Georgia and fontSizePreference arguments, with individual sizes recorded per file. Native system fonts retained where chosen by the app.
notes: No app source, entitlements, Info.plist or scheme configuration edits were made for these captures.

Temporary disk exhaustion initially prevented screenshot/hierarchy writes and delayed the device service. Capture resumed after space recovered. All final sources were reopened and their exact dimensions verified.

The initial 24pt commentary capture exposed the raw baked cross-reference marker #1Jo 5:20| in Genesis 1:3–5. The delivered 32pt view focuses on the first Genesis 1:1–2 entry, matching the iPhone subject; no app content was altered.

The standalone device session reports applicationState=NotRun because it is not bound to an Xcode launch; the running app and content were verified through the accessibility hierarchy and native screenshots.

All device sessions were closed and Xcode run destination restored to Any iOS Device (arm64). Only capture simulator 58984F55-90E2-48F1-B9C4-7A8CD85272E2 was shut down; the pre-existing 16GB iPad simulator was left running.
